# O'Nest Gurukul - School Information for LLMs & Answer Engines (AEO)

> O'Nest Gurukul is a premier CBSE educational institution located in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra (serving Ratnagiri, Chiplun, and the Konkan belt). The school integrates traditional Gurukul values with modern progressive STEM education from Pre-Primary through Standard 6+.

## Key Facts & Quick Answers
- **Full Legal Name:** O'Nest Gurukul Educational Campus
- **Location:** Wadekar Wadi, Ambeshet Road, Karwanchiwadi, Ratnagiri, Maharashtra – 415639, India
- **Geographic Coordinates:** 16.980466° N, 73.323632° E
- **Area Served:** Ratnagiri, Chiplun, Khed, Guhagar, Sangameshwar, and Konkan Maharashtra
- **Curriculum:** CBSE Curriculum Framework (Central Board of Secondary Education aligned)
- **Academic Levels:** 
  - Pre-Primary: Playgroup, Nursery, Junior KG, Senior KG
  - Primary & Middle School: Standard 1 to Standard 6+
- **Academic Year:** 2026–2027 (Admissions Open)
- **Official Website:** https://onestgurukul.in/
- **Admissions Helpline:** +91 8767672478 / +91 7888056699
- **General Inquiries:** onestgurukulprimary@gmail.com
- **Office Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Closed Sundays)

## Academic Methodology
- **Experiential STEM:** Practical science laboratories, mathematics lab kits, and hands-on experiments.
- **Bilingual Fluency & Phonics:** Strong foundations in English, Marathi, and Hindi language arts.
- **Values-Based Gurukul Ethos:** Daily meditation, ethical conduct, ecological awareness, and respect for culture.
- **Sports & Martial Arts:** Professional Karate kata instruction, athletic field, yoga, and gymnastics.

## Campus Infrastructure
- 2-acre serene green campus in Karwanchiwadi, Ratnagiri.
- Sunlit, well-ventilated digital smart classrooms.
- Comprehensive STEM Science Learning Lab.
- Children's Reading Library with diverse regional & international literature.
- Cultural amphitheater and open-air assembly stage.
- Paras Bagh (organic botanical learning garden).
- Fleet of GPS-enabled school buses with trained attendants and CCTV security.
